# Transferring Files with Code

Podemos usar lenguajes de programación para transferencias más controladas.

## Python

### Download File

```python
# Python 3
import urllib.request

url = 'https://example.com/file.txt'
urllib.request.urlretrieve(url, 'file.txt')

# Con requests (requiere instalación)
import requests
r = requests.get('https://example.com/file.txt')
open('file.txt', 'wb').write(r.content)
```

### Upload File

```python
import requests

files = {'file': open('file.txt', 'rb')}
r = requests.post('https://example.com/upload', files=files)
```

### HTTP Server

```python
# Servidor simple
python3 -m http.server 8000

# Servidor con upload
from http.server import HTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler
import os

class UploadHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_POST(self):
        length = int(self.headers['Content-Length'])
        data = self.rfile.read(length)
        with open('uploaded_file', 'wb') as f:
            f.write(data)
        self.send_response(200)
        self.end_headers()

HTTPServer(('', 8000), UploadHandler).serve_forever()
```

## PHP

### Download File

```php
<?php
file_put_contents('file.txt', file_get_contents('https://example.com/file.txt'));
?>
```

### Upload File

```php
<?php
$ch = curl_init('https://example.com/upload');
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POST, true);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, [
    'file' => new CURLFile('file.txt')
]);
curl_exec($ch);
curl_close($ch);
?>
```

## Ruby

### Download File

```ruby
require 'net/http'
uri = URI('https://example.com/file.txt')
Net::HTTP.start(uri.host, uri.port, use_ssl: true) do |http|
  request = Net::HTTP::Get.new(uri)
  File.write('file.txt', http.request(request).body)
end
```

## Perl

### Download File

```perl
use LWP::Simple;
getstore('https://example.com/file.txt', 'file.txt');
```

## JavaScript (Node.js)

### Download File

```javascript
const https = require('https');
const fs = require('fs');

const file = fs.createWriteStream('file.txt');
https.get('https://example.com/file.txt', (response) => {
  response.pipe(file);
});
```

## Go

### Download File

```go
package main

import (
    "io"
    "net/http"
    "os"
)

func main() {
    resp, _ := http.Get("https://example.com/file.txt")
    defer resp.Body.Close()
    out, _ := os.Create("file.txt")
    defer out.Close()
    io.Copy(out, resp.Body)
}
```

## Resumen

| Lenguaje | Librería | Uso |
|----------|----------|-----|
| Python | urllib, requests | Download/Upload |
| PHP | file_get_contents, curl | Download/Upload |
| Ruby | net/http | Download/Upload |
| Perl | LWP::Simple | Download |
| Node.js | https, fs | Download |
| Go | net/http | Download |
